import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    b = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    a = [0] * n
    a[0] = max(b) + 1
    for i in range(n):
        if b[i] >= a[i]:
            print("NO")
            return
        a[(i + 1) % n] = a[i] - b[i]

    print("YES")
    print(" ".join(map(str, a)))

main()
